request.state:
L01: The boathouse hires rowing boats by the hour.
L02: A hire begins when the keys are handed over.
L03: A deposit of forty pounds is taken at the desk.
L04: The deposit comes back when the boat is tied up again.
L05: Life jackets are included in the hire.
L06: A lost life jacket is charged at cost.
L07: Boats must be back before dusk.
L08: The warden logs every return.
L09: A boat returned after its hour costs six pounds for each further half hour.
L10: The warden may refuse a hire in bad weather.
L11: A refused hire is refunded in full.
L12: Groups of more than six book by telephone.
L13: The boathouse closes on the first Monday of each month.

q1.instructions: Which line gives the amount charged for returning a hired boat late?
